notes.title: 'At the Dream End 2' is Now Available on Steam, GameJolt, and Itch.io!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=KRtxYWz023U;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello, dear players!

We're thrilled to announce that 'At the Dream End 2' has officially been completed and is now available on Steam, GameJolt, and Itch.io. It's been an incredible journey, and we can't wait to share this sci-fi, horror, dreamlike adventure with you. 

We value your feedback and would love to hear about your experience with 'At the Dream End 2.' Please don't hesitate to share your thoughts, insights, and any feedback you might have. We believe your input is invaluable in our quest to create captivating, dream-inspired games.

Bonus Content: As a token of our appreciation for your support, we've prepared a special bonus for you! In addition to the game, you can also find a downloadable PDF containing extra images, in-depth story insights, and a helpful walkthrough guide. Explore the game's world on a deeper level, uncover its secrets, and make your journey through 'At the Dream End 2' even more memorable.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Upgraded Demo of 'At the Dream End 2' Coming Soon!"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44211708/4a4886f29fbbe7ae788e1c9a0ca5f81bddf3bc84.png[/img]

Hello, gamers and fans of the "At the Dream End" series!
We're thrilled to share some updates about the upcoming release of "At the Dream End 2" (ATDE2). While we're putting the finishing touches on the upgraded demo, we'd like to give you a sneak peek into what you can expect from this sequel.

One of the significant changes is how players explore the in-game world. In "At the Dream End 1," players progressed through different locations without the ability to return to previous ones. However, in "At the Dream End 2," we're granting players the freedom to revisit all locations at any point in the game. This means you can explore the game world at your own pace and immerse yourself fully in the experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44211708/6a4fa1df9e414c11f4e00599ca20d517d58b208b.png[/img]

Now, the best part: the upgraded demo of "ATDE2" is just around the corner! We're aiming to have it completed and uploaded by the end of next week. 

In the meantime, if you haven't already, you can try out "ATDE1" to get a feel for the series, or you can explore the current demo of "ATDE2" and provide us with your valuable feedback.
Your feedback is crucial to us as it helps us create the best possible version of the game. We appreciate every comment, suggestion, and bug report. Together, we can make "ATDE2" an unforgettable gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44211708/0a83159ea71ae303112cc74f1f6a5dff532f980c.png[/img]

If you find yourself enjoying our games, please consider clicking on the Wishlist button to stay updated with the latest news and developments regarding "ATDE2." Be among the first to receive exciting updates and announcements about the game.

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm for the "At the Dream End" series. We can't wait to embark on this new adventure with you, and we look forward to sharing more details about "ATDE2" soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44211708/1cca3c76614e4f0b4f7bebe41d9330db552d79cc.png[/img]

notes.title: At the Dream End 2 - New gameplay, new demo!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44211708/ebdf4390b1eff7e98dd689c61254c35b46a58822.png[/img]

First of all, we'd like to apologize for the irregular updates lately. We've been working tirelessly to improve the gameplay as much as possible because, frankly, the previous version of the game had little to offer beyond its atmospheric appeal. We've also received feedback that the current version of the game looked extremely different from the first installment, 'At the Dream End 1,' and we completely agree. That's why, in the past month, we've decided to go back to the drawing board and figure out how to make 'ATDE 2' a true and worthy sequel. We believe we've found the solution, and we want to share a demo of the new 'ATDE 2' version with you today.

In this demo, players will once again step into the shoes of the wolf and explore mystical landscapes as they embark on a journey they believe will lead to the salvation of the planet. The gameplay in the new version will harken back much closer to the original 'ATDE 1,' while expanding significantly on the game world itself.

We hope you enjoy this new demo, and we eagerly anticipate your comments and feedback, which will help us create the best version of the game possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44211708/f93b3a1c3a3d4c7cada7f4b7e2c2320dec8cb338.png[/img]
